# Drawing Dog

> > Drawing Dog offers 60+ online art courses specializing in watercolor painting techniques taught by master instructors across landscapes, seascapes, florals, and wildlife.

Drawing Dog is an online art school featuring instructor-led courses in watercolor, pastel, and drawing for all skill levels. The platform emphasizes practical painting techniques like alla prima, wet-on-wet, and composition through structured courses organized by subject matter and instructor expertise.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Alla prima technique
- Landscape painting
- Seascape painting
- Wet-on-wet technique
- Online art courses
- Light and shadow
- Composition
- Ilya Ibryaev
- Natalia Nesterova
- Dmitry Gutov
- Igor Khaikov
- Drawing Dog School
- Painting techniques
- Beginner-friendly instruction

## Featured Courses & Instructors

- [Online Painting & Drawing Courses — Watercolor, Pastel & More](https://drawing-dog.com): Drawing Dog homepage: 60+ online art courses in watercolor, pastel, pencil for all levels.
- [Art History and Painting — Courses with Dmitry Gutov](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/gutov-art): Art history and painting courses with Dmitry Gutov: composition, perspective, theory.
- [Drawing Dog School Marathons](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/marafons): Directory of Drawing Dog School marathons and instructor-led online workshops.

## Landscape & Nature Watercolor Courses

- [Light and Space with Ilya Ibryaev](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/light): 10 landscape watercolors in alla prima technique with Ilya Ibryaev.
- [Countryside Landscapes — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/countryside): 11 rural landscape watercolors using dry and wet paper techniques with Igor Khaikov.
- [Seasons with Ilya Ibryaev — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/seasons-ibryaev): 10 seasonal landscape watercolors in alla prima technique with Ilya Ibryaev.
- [Light in Urban Watercolors — Online Art Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/lightinthecity): 8 urban landscapes with light and mood in watercolor with Igor Khaikov.
- [Minimalist Landscapes — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/minaqualand): 12 meditative grisaille Siberian landscape paintings with Alexandra Podushkina.
- [Light 2.0: Transformation of Light — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/light2): 16 alla prima scenes: still lifes, landscapes, portraits with Ilya Ibryaev.
- [Airy Landscapes — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/airlands): 10 light, airy landscapes in alla prima technique with Alena Kruglova.

## Seascape & Coastal Watercolor Courses

- [Winter Sea — Advanced Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/winter-sea): Advanced watercolor course: 6 winter seascapes with composition & atmosphere techniques.
- [SEA TRIP with Natalia Nesterova](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/sea): 11 realistic sea paintings in watercolor with Natalia Nesterova.
- [The Sea in Watercolor — Advanced Online Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/bigmore): Advanced marine watercolor: detailed sea paintings with Natalia Nesterova.
- [Coastal Italy — Advanced Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/coastalitaly): 6 advanced Italian coastal paintings with architecture & night landscapes.

## Urban & Travel Watercolor Courses

- [Watercolor Journey — Online Art Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/watercolorjourney): 8 international cityscapes in watercolor: wet effects and depth with Julia Zilbert.
- [Urban Moments — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/citymoments): 10 atmospheric urban scenes in watercolor with Olga Ovtina.
- [Vintage Watercolor — Online Art Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/vintage): 12 nostalgic vintage watercolor scenes with texture effects by Nina Orlova.

## Botanical & Wildlife Watercolor Courses

- [Flowers and Bouquets — Online Watercolor Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/flowers): 12 flower arrangements and watercolor techniques for stylized floral painting.
- [Exotic in Watercolor — Online Art Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/ekzotikakvarel): 15 vivid exotic nature paintings: birds, fruits, animals with Margarita Astashova.
- [Watercolor Animalistics — Online Art Course](https://drawing-dog.com/pages/akvarelanimal): 12 realistic wildlife paintings in watercolor with Anna Parshenko.
